firm_data.firm_description: Edelman, Krasin & Jaye, PLLC is a law firm that provides legal services to clients in various practice areas, including personal injury, workers’ compensation, and criminal defense. They represent victims from all over the country in serious personal injury lawsuits, class action lawsuits, labor law issues, federal claims and pharmaceutical mass torts.
notable_facts: Offices throughout New York including Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn, and Long Island
Represent victims from all over the country
Offer free legal consultation and accept cases on a contingency basis

email.subject: AI for Edelman, Krasin & Jaye, PLLC: built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Carissa,

Edelman, Krasin & Jaye represents victims across the country in serious personal injury lawsuits, class actions, and mass torts. That means your team handles high-stakes cases that demand precision and speed, but likely without the back-office resources of BigLaw.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing exactly these demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: client trust, precision, and real efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're arriving in the New York region to meet firms. I'd be happy to stop by Westbury on a day that works for you to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
